errors.evidence: The description states the accuracy for VADER is 0.48 for "Emoji Tweets" and 0.44 for "Overall Tweets". Visually, the bar for "Overall Tweets" (approx. 0.47) is slightly higher than for "Emoji Tweets" (approx. 0.46). The reported values (0.48 > 0.44) incorrectly reverse this relationship.
In the "Overall Tweets" category, the bar for TEXTBLOB clearly aligns with the 0.4 gridline, but the description states its value is approximately 0.38.
In the "Overall Tweets" category, the bar for VADER is visibly higher than the TEXTBLOB bar (at 0.4) and is at approximately 0.47. The reported value of 0.44 is a significant underestimation.
The description fails to mention the subtitle on the horizontal axis: "Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis".
The description does not mention the presence or location of the legend, which is on the right side of the chart.
